recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the active current-build surfaces for FHIR-34351 without changing the already-valid subjectResults/List option or adding a broader invariant beyond the existing SHALL-level comments.
issue_request: FHIR-34351 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core CQI change request for R6. It asked to add repeatable subjectReport Reference(MeasureReport) elements wherever MeasureReport subjectResults exists, make direct subjectReport references exclusive with subjectResults/List indirection, document both options, and add an example of the direct subjectReport form.
initial_application: Commits 72279787934ea6bfe24ddf6b864bb6e7832ba4f0 and 079852f778b88cb83c88317e1de57385c1a2bcc4 added MeasureReport.group.population.subjectReport and MeasureReport.group.stratifier.stratum.population.subjectReport to the StructureDefinition. Commit 9ba5869242d1fcf01e610e9d2c158076e3d2ec9c added the quality-reporting narrative and updated the group-level subjectReport short description, but current source still lacked a direct subjectReport example, subjectReport ModelInfo entries, and the same short-definition wording on the stratum population element.
additional_context: MeasureReport and Library are active resources in source/fhir.ini. The edited subject-list MeasureReport example is registered in source/measurereport/list-MeasureReport-examples.xml, and Library/library-fhir-model-definition is registered as the FHIR Model Definition example. FHIR-49941 later corrected subjectReport comments and related documentation; this reconciliation preserves those later changes and fills the remaining FHIR-34351 gaps. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published a non-empty source commit that aligns the stratum subjectReport short description with the accepted wording, converts the registered subject-list example to two direct subjectReport references, labels that example accordingly, adds subjectReport as List<FHIR.Reference> on both MeasureReport population ModelInfo classes, and refreshes the embedded ModelInfo Library attachment from the raw content.
